assumptions.unit_economics: 60% cost / 40% margin of seller median price
assumptions.lead_time: per-seller mean/std from Olist delivery history
assumptions.arm_A: order a fixed quantity equal to historical mean demand every day
assumptions.arm_B: order the seasonal-naive point forecast every day
assumptions.arm_C: order-up-to the Monte-Carlo P90 of demand over lead time + review
